text:
tara: Heads up — need a quick sync on audit provenance + retention guardrails for the enterprise roadmap. Customer asks piling up (BYOK, per-tenant retention, legal hold). Can we list the absolute launch must-haves and the nice-to-haves?

sam: +1. For security: MVP should include BYOK handshake (CMEK), tenant-scoped audit export, and tamper-evident append-only logs. We also need clear retention buckets (30/90/365) and a legal-hold override path.

raj: From infra POV: big note on indexing vs raw storage. Full indexing for search kills cost. Propose default: index metadata + sampling for long tail and keep raw objects in cold archive.

olivia: Legal: SOC2 requires evidence of access + integrity for audit logs. For ISO, we need encryption-at-rest + key management attestation. Also require an exportable chain-of-custody bundle for eDiscovery.

kim: To make this actionable for roadmap, suggest we define: 1) Launch criteria (must pass): BYOK handoff spec, export format (JSONL with provenance metadata), retention toggle UI + API, legal-hold API. 2) Phase 2: search SLA, indexing config, cross-region replay.

raj: Quick config sketch — sample retention config snippet: 
```
retention: 
  default_days: 90
  tiers: [30,90,365]
  legal_hold: true
  index_mode: metadata_only
```
This keeps indexing cheap and gives customers toggles.

sam: We should also document threat model: what constitutes tampering, rollback detection, and who can trigger key-rotation. That affects design of the append-only store and proof artifacts.

olivia: Add legal-hold UX requirement: when legal hold is on, retention TTL must be suspended and there must be an auditable who/when/why. Exports must include signed manifest.

kim: Operational ask — need an ops runbook + oncall playbook for evidence requests and retention overrides before GA. Also, define SLOs for export latency (e.g., 95% < 2h for <=30 days).

tara: Good list. Let's prioritize: (A) BYOK handshake + signed export manifest, (B) retention API/UI + legal-hold suspend, (C) minimal provenance metadata & index-mode. (D) Search SLA and archival sampling as follow-ups.

sam: Agree. I'll draft the security spec for BYOK + tamper proofs by EOD tomorrow and link here.

raj: I'll size the infra work (ingest path + cold archive + index switch) and drop estimates in the ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket #PROD-8721 "Audit provenance & retention MVP" and assigned to @tara, @sam, @raj.

tara: Perfect — thanks everyone. Posting this to the roadmap doc after we get the security spec and sizing. :thumbsup:
